title: Portfolio Engine
description: High-performance portfolio featuring custom cursor physics, 3D particles, and GSAP-powered scroll animations.
longDescription: A high-performance portfolio system built with Astro, React, and Three.js featuring custom cursor physics with lerp smoothing, GSAP-powered scroll animations with persistent triggers, smooth scrolling via Lenis, and an interactive 3D particle system that reacts to mouse movement. Every animation is crafted to feel cinematic and immersive.
